question: क्या हम हवा (Wind) को देख सकते हैं? 🌬️
explanation: Great job! We cannot see the हवा (Wind), but we can feel it! 🌬️
hint: You feel it on your face, but it is invisible.

question: हवा चलने पर पेड़ों के क्या हिलते (Move) हैं? 🍃
explanation: Awesome! The wind makes the पत्ते (Leaves) on the trees dance and move! 🌳
hint: They are green and grow on trees.

question: हम हवा (Wind) को कैसे महसूस (Feel) करते हैं? 😌
explanation: Super star! We can feel the cool हवा (Wind) touching our skin! 😌
hint: It is the outer covering of our body.

question: हवा (Wind) में हम क्या उड़ाते (Fly) हैं? 🪁
explanation: Yay! We use the wind to fly a colorful पतंग (Kite) high in the sky! 🪁
hint: It has a string and flies in the sky.

question: तेज़ हवा (Strong wind) को क्या कहते हैं? 🌪️
explanation: Excellent! Very strong wind is called आँधी (Storm)! 🌪️
hint: It blows very fast and kicks up dust.

question: तेज़ हवा में हमारे सिर के क्या उड़ते (Fly) हैं? 💇
explanation: Great job! The breeze makes our बाल (Hair) fly around playfully! 💇
hint: It grows on top of your head.

question: हवा से क्या जल्दी सूखते (Dry) हैं? 👕
explanation: Awesome! The wind helps our गीले कपड़े (Wet clothes) dry faster on the line! 👕
hint: Things we wear after washing them.

question: हवा (Wind) में कौन सा खिलौना (Toy) गोल घूमता है? 🎐
explanation: Yay! A colorful फिरकी (Pinwheel) spins fast when the wind blows! 🎐
hint: It is made of paper and spins.

question: हवा (Wind) आसमान में किसे धकेलती (Pushes) है? ☁️
explanation: Super star! The wind blows and pushes the बादल (Clouds) across the sky! ☁️
hint: They are fluffy and white in the sky.

question: गर्मियों (Summer) में कैसी हवा चलती है? ☀️
explanation: Great job! In the summer, we feel गर्म (Hot) wind called Loo! ☀️
hint: Like the heat from a fire.

question: सर्दियों (Winter) में हवा कैसी महसूस (Feel) होती है? ❄️
explanation: Awesome! Winter wind feels very ठंडी (Cold) and chilly! ❄️
hint: Like ice cream.

question: हवा चलने पर क्या उड़ने (Fly) लगता है? 📄
explanation: Yay! Light things like कागज़ (Paper) fly away in the wind! 📄
hint: You write and draw on it.

question: सांस (Breath) लेने के लिए हमें क्या चाहिए? 🌬️
explanation: Super star! We all need fresh हवा (Air) to breathe and live! 🌬️
hint: It is all around us, keeping us alive.

question: हवा (Wind) पानी में किसे चलाती है? ⛵
explanation: Great job! The wind pushes the sails to move a नाव (Boat) in water! ⛵
hint: It floats on the river.

question: हवा चलने पर क्या लहराता (Flutters) है? 🇮🇳
explanation: Awesome! Our beautiful झंडा (Flag) flutters proudly in the wind! 🇮🇳
hint: It has three colors and a wheel.

question: हम हवा (Air) किसमें भरते (Fill) हैं? 🎈
explanation: Yay! We blow हवा (Air) into a balloon to make it big and round! 🎈
hint: It pops if you poke it with a pin.

question: फूलों की खुशबू (Smell) हमारे पास कैसे पहुँचती है? 🌸
explanation: Super star! The gentle हवा (Wind) carries sweet smells to our nose! 🌸
hint: It carries the smell through the air.

question: तेज़ हवा चलने पर पेड़ (Trees) कैसे लगते हैं? 🌳
explanation: Great job! The strong wind makes the trees bend and sway! 🌳
hint: They lean to one side.

question: हवा (Wind) में हल्का क्या होता है जो उड़ता है? 🪶
explanation: Awesome! A light पंख (Feather) floats beautifully in the wind! 🪶
hint: It comes from a bird.

question: तेज़ आँधी (Storm) में क्या उड़ सकती है? 🧢
explanation: Yay! Hold on to your टोपी (Cap), the wind might blow it away! 🧢
hint: You wear it on your head to block the sun.

question: जब हवा तेज़ चलती है, तो क्या बंद (Close) करना चाहिए? 🚪
explanation: Super star! We close the दरवाज़ा (Door) so the strong wind does not come inside! 🚪
hint: You open it to enter a room.

question: हम मुँह से फूँक मारकर क्या बुझाते (Blow out) हैं? 🕯️
explanation: Great job! We use air from our mouth to blow out a मोमबत्ती (Candle)! 🕯️
hint: It gives light on a birthday cake.

question: हवा (Air) किस चीज़ के अंदर होती है? ⚽
explanation: Awesome! A फुटबॉल (Football) bounces nicely because it is full of air! ⚽
hint: A round toy you kick to play a game.

question: सुहानी हवा (Breeze) चलने पर कैसा लगता है? 😊
explanation: Yay! A cool, gentle breeze makes everyone feel very अच्छा (Good) and happy! 😊
hint: A happy feeling.

question: गर्मियों में हवा खाने के लिए हम क्या चलाते हैं? 🌀
explanation: Super star! A पंखा (Fan) spins to give us cool air in the summer! 🌀
hint: It is on the ceiling and spins round and round.

question: साइकिल के टायर (Tire) में क्या भरा होता है? 🚲
explanation: Great job! We fill हवा (Air) in tires so the bicycle can run smoothly! 🚲
hint: The invisible thing we breathe.

question: कौन सा पक्षी (Bird) हवा में आसानी से उड़ता है? 🦅
explanation: Awesome! A चील (Eagle) uses the wind to fly very high in the sky! 🦅
hint: It has big wings and flies in the sky.

question: हवा में साबुन के क्या उड़ते (Fly) हैं? 🫧
explanation: Yay! Blowing soapy बुलबुले (Bubbles) into the wind is so much fun! 🫧
hint: They are round, colorful, and pop easily.

question: हवा से कौन सा वाद्य यंत्र (Instrument) बजता है? 🪈
explanation: Super star! We blow air into a बाँसुरी (Flute) to make sweet music! 🪈
hint: It is a long pipe with holes in it.

question: तेज़ हवा (Wind) में छाते (Umbrella) का क्या हो सकता है? ☔
explanation: Great job! A strong gust of wind can make an umbrella उलट जाना (Flip) inside out! ☔
hint: Turn upside down.

question: हवा से क्या उड़कर हमारी आँखों में जा सकता है? 🌫️
explanation: Awesome! In a storm, we should cover our eyes so धूल (Dust) does not go inside! 🌫️
hint: Tiny dry particles from the ground.

question: हवा में पेड़ से टूटकर क्या गिरते (Fall) हैं? 🍂
explanation: Yay! The wind shakes the trees, and सूखे पत्ते (Dry leaves) fall to the ground! 🍂
hint: They are brown or yellow and fall in autumn.

question: जब हमें गर्मी लगती है, तो हम कागज़ से क्या झलते (Fan) हैं? 📄
explanation: Super star! We can fan ourselves with a paper to feel cool हवा (Air)! 🌬️
hint: The invisible breeze.

question: हवा (Wind) होने पर हम क्या बनाकर पानी में चलाते हैं? ⛵
explanation: Great job! A कागज़ की नाव (Paper boat) floats and moves nicely with the wind! ⛵
hint: A toy ship made of paper.

question: हवा में कागज़ का क्या उड़ता (Flies) है? ✈️
explanation: Awesome! We love making a paper हवाई जहाज़ (Airplane) and flying it in the air! ✈️
hint: A flying machine.

question: हवा (Wind) कहाँ-कहाँ होती है? 🌍
explanation: Yay! Air is present हर जगह (Everywhere) around us, all the time! 🌍
hint: In all places.

question: मुँह से सीटी (Whistle) बजाने के लिए क्या बाहर निकालते हैं? 😙
explanation: Super star! We blow हवा (Air) softly through our lips to whistle! 😙
hint: Our breath.

question: तेज़ आँधी (Storm) में जानवर (Animals) कहाँ छुपते हैं? 🌳
explanation: Great job! Animals find a सुरक्षित जगह (Safe place) to hide from bad weather! 🛡️
hint: A place where they are protected.

question: पहाड़ों पर हवा कैसी होती है? 🏔️
explanation: Awesome! High up in the mountains, the wind is बहुत ठंडी (Very cold)! 🥶
hint: Chilly like a freezer.

question: खिड़की (Window) खोलने पर कमरे में क्या आती है? 🪟
explanation: Yay! Opening windows lets beautiful ताज़ा हवा (Fresh air) inside the house! 🌬️
hint: Good, clean air.

question: कचरा (Garbage) हवा में उड़कर कहाँ फैल सकता है? 🗑️
explanation: Super star! Wind can blow loose garbage हर जगह (Everywhere), so we must use a dustbin! 🗑️
hint: All over the place.

question: हमें कैसे पता चलता है कि हवा (Wind) चल रही है? 👀
explanation: Great job! We know wind is blowing when चीज़ें हिलती हैं (Things move) around us! 🍃
hint: Leaves swaying, paper flying.

question: अगर हम दौड़ते हैं, तो हवा कैसी लगती है? 🏃
explanation: Awesome! When you run fast, the air feels like a तेज़ (Fast) wind on your face! 💨
hint: Very quick.

question: हवा में क्या सुखद आवाज़ (Sound) करता है? 🎐
explanation: Yay! A विंड चाइम (Wind chime) makes lovely tinkling sounds in the breeze! 🎐
hint: Hanging bells that ring in the wind.

question: हवा के कारण आग (Fire) कैसी हो सकती है? 🔥
explanation: Super star! Strong wind makes a fire बढ़ सकती है (Can grow) bigger and faster! 🔥
hint: It gets larger.

question: हवा (Wind) से हमें क्या आराम (Relief) मिलता है? 😅
explanation: Great job! A cool breeze helps our पसीना सूखता है (Sweat dries) after playing! 😅
hint: The wet drops on skin go away.

question: पवन चक्की (Windmill) किससे घूमती है? 🌾
explanation: Awesome! A windmill needs strong हवा (Wind) to turn its giant blades! 🌬️
hint: The invisible moving air.

question: पैराशूट (Parachute) किससे नीचे आता है? 🪂
explanation: Yay! A parachute fills with हवा (Air) to land someone safely! 🪂
hint: It catches the wind like a big umbrella.

question: हवा चलने पर खेत की फसल (Crops) कैसी दिखती है? 🌾
explanation: Super star! Beautiful green fields look लहराती हुई (Swaying) like green waves in the wind! 🌾
hint: Moving side to side gently.

question: हवा (Wind) हमारी क्या है? 🤝
explanation: Great job! Wind brings cool breezes and fresh air, so it is our दोस्त (Friend)! 🤝
hint: A buddy who helps us.
